chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Najiyah, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Salim, from his father, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام:
Its like; that is, the same as it.

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, the source of the hadith.
key_terms.أَبِيهِ: Refers to the narrator's father in the chain of transmission.
key_terms.عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ: Name of a transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدُ: A narrator name appearing in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: Meaning that this report is the same as the preceding one in wording or ruling.

ai.seo_question: What does "مِثْلُهُ" mean in a hadith chain in Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This report provides only the sanad/isnad and then states "mithluhu," indicating that its matn is the same as the immediately preceding hadith. Its significance is chiefly in transmission, showing another route for the same legal narration in the chapter on liabilities for lives and related matters.
